_readme: Every string a person or a crawler reads on /, /ai, /pricing/, /downloads/ and /faq. tools/build-pages.mjs renders src/pages/<page>.html with it.

Strings are HTML as it appears in the page: & is &, and inline markup (<a>, <code>, <strong>, <span>) stays inside the string. A translation keeps every tag and attribute and {{href.*}} exactly; the build fails if the markup differs from English.
JSON-LD reads the same strings with the tags stripped, so the FAQPage answers are the visible answers. jsonld.* keys are JSON-LD only and plain text.
common: the nav, footer and site script (also read by the blog), store badges, the offers the homepage and /pricing/ share word for word, and lines several pages repeat.
pages.<page>.updated is the page sitemap lastmod and its JSON-LD dateModified: change the page, move the date.
lang: ogLocale is the og:locale value, captures the folder of the localised screenshots. Sentence case, no em dash.

what.a: Dovilo is a gamified productivity app that combines a to-do list, focus sessions with full-screen ambience, and an isometric city builder. Complete your tasks and focus sessions to earn bricks, then build houses, offices, parks, and more in your own virtual city.

free.a: Yes. The free tier includes full to-do management, unlimited tasks and categories, unlimited focus sessions, basic city building, dark & light themes, and zero ads. Pro adds planning with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok, 15 AI tasks a month for coding agents, the desktop app for Windows and Mac, cloud sync, the Focus Ambience Pack, all buildings and advanced statistics, from $2.49 a month, and it starts with a 7-day free trial, so you can try everything before paying. Cancel before the week is up and nothing is charged.

plan.q: Can I plan with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok?
plan.a: Yes. Add Dovilo to the assistant as a custom connector with the URL https://dovilo.app/mcp and sign in with your Dovilo account. The assistant proposes a plan, the plan lands in the AI inbox on your phone, and it goes into your lists with one tap once you approve it. For each connection you choose what the assistant can read and which lists and projects it sees, and its changes always wait for your approval; the setting is called Ask me first. There is no delete tool, and you can revoke a connection from your phone at any time. Sending a plan works on Free; approving it, and everything else, needs Pro.

focus.a: Focus was rebuilt. You can run a single session, a Pomodoro cycle (25 minutes of focus, a 5 minute break, a longer break every 4 rounds), or a session bound to one specific task. The timer keeps counting while the app is in the background or your phone is locked, Do Not Disturb silences other apps during the session, and every scene brings its own ambience: Rainy City, Midnight, Dusk, Snow or Fog.

ambience.q: Do I need the Focus Ambience Pack?
ambience.a: No. Focus sessions and Pomodoro cycles are free and unlimited, and the Default scene is always available and is simply silent. The Focus Ambience Pack adds the 5 atmospheric scenes and 16 sound layers you can blend three at a time. It is a one-time $4.99 purchase, and it is already included with Pro.

offline.a: Yes. Dovilo is offline-first. All your tasks, focus sessions, and city progress are stored locally on your device. Cloud sync is an optional Pro feature for keeping data across multiple devices.

ads.a: No. Dovilo is completely ad-free, both in the free tier and in Pro. We believe ads break focus, which is the opposite of what a productivity app should do.

desktop.q: Does my coding agent need Dovilo Desktop running?
desktop.a: No. Since Dovilo 2.0, coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor connect to Dovilo's remote MCP server at https://dovilo.app/mcp/agents with a key you create in the app, from your laptop, a server or a CI runner. Desktop does not need to be open; it is the desktop client for your lists and AI tasks. The agent sees only the AI tasks of the projects you assign to it, and it cannot create or delete tasks. Agents are part of Pro. Coming from Desktop 1.8? Its built-in MCP server stops working with 2.0, so reconnect your agent with the new URL and a new key. Setup is on the developer page.

aiTasks.q: How many AI tasks does Pro include?
aiTasks.a: 15 AI tasks a month. A task counts when it opens to your agent, not when you create it, and replies on the same task cost nothing. If you need more, one-time top-up packs add 10, 30 or 75 AI tasks, start at $0.99 and never expire.

cancel.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
cancel.a: Subscriptions are managed through the Apple App Store or Google Play Store. To cancel, go to your device's subscription settings. You'll retain Pro access until the end of your current billing period.

what.summary: What a gamified to-do list does once it is installed
what.p1: Dovilo attaches the game to finishing the work, not to planning it. Every task you complete and every focus session you run pays out in bricks, and bricks are the only currency in the Market, where you buy the houses, offices, parks and roads you then place yourself on an isometric grid. The city is the record of what you actually got through, which is what makes it worth opening on a day the list is not.
what.p2: Four things live in the one app. Tasks carry due dates, repeats, reminders, stars, flags and your own lists, behind a single view picker holding My Day, Important, Planned, Flagged and every custom list with a live count. Focus runs in three shapes: one session of any length from 1 to 180 minutes, a Pomodoro cycle of 25 minutes with a 5 minute break and a longer break every 4 rounds, or a session bound to one task. The timer keeps counting while the app is backgrounded or the phone is locked. Ambience fills the screen for the length of a session: six scenes, and up to three sound layers blended at once out of sixteen. It is ambience rather than music, so there is no melody or beat to follow. AI tasks are a separate list you keep for coding agents, which work through it over remote MCP from any machine.
what.p3: All of it is offline-first: tasks, focus history and the city sit on the device, and no internet connection is needed to use the app. Cloud sync is optional and comes with Pro. There are no ads on any tier, the app ships in English, Turkish, Spanish, French and German, and both the dark and the light theme are free.

which.p1: The mobile apps are the free ones, and free here is the whole product rather than a trial: a download from the App Store or Google Play gives you full to-do management, unlimited single and Pomodoro focus sessions, the silent Default ambience scene, city building, both themes and no ads. The desktop apps are the Pro half. They carry two task surfaces on a full-size screen, full to-do management for your own list and AI task management for your agents, with focus sessions and the city staying on mobile. Desktop is also where you set up the signed webhooks, so it needs an active subscription, which you start in the mobile app. Coding agents do not need it: they connect to Dovilo directly, with a key you can create on the phone or on the desktop.

pro.summary: What is free, and what Pro adds
pro.p1: Pro is $2.49 a month, $19.99 a year or $49.99 once, and it begins with a 7-day free trial you start in the iOS or Android app. It adds planning with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok, approved in Dovilo; AI Agents like Claude Code and Cursor working through 15 AI tasks a month over remote MCP; the Windows and Mac desktop app, where webhooks are set up; cloud sync across devices; both one-time packs, the Focus Ambience Pack and the Full City Package; advanced statistics; +6 build permits a day; and a 30-minute snooze from the reminder notification. The same subscription is what unlocks Desktop, so the desktop app is never a separate purchase.
pro.p2: Two one-time packs sit outside the subscription: the Focus Ambience Pack at $4.99, which adds the five atmospheric scenes and the sixteen sound layers, and the Full City Package at $4.99, which adds every building, decoration and upgrade. Neither is a subscription, and Pro already includes both. AI task packs start at $0.99 for 10, 30 or 75 extra agent tasks, and they never expire. Prices are the USD store baseline; each store applies its own regional pricing.

free.a: The iPhone, iPad and Android apps are free and ad-free. The free tier covers full to-do management, unlimited single and Pomodoro focus sessions, the silent Default ambience scene, basic city building and both the dark and the light theme. The Windows and Mac desktop apps are the two downloads that need an active Pro subscription.

install.q: How do I install Dovilo Desktop on Windows or Mac?
install.a: Subscribe to Pro in the iOS or Android app first: the desktop app needs an active subscription, and the same subscription unlocks it, so there is no separate desktop purchase. Then download Dovilo-Setup.exe or Dovilo.dmg from the desktop section of this page. Both come from Dovilo's public releases repository, and the app updates itself from there afterwards.

trial.q: Can I try Pro before paying for it?
trial.a: Yes. Pro starts with a 7-day free trial, begun from the iOS or Android app. After that it is $2.49 a month, $19.99 a year or $49.99 once. Prices are the USD store baseline, and each store applies its own regional pricing.

updates.q: Do I have to download Dovilo again when it updates?
updates.a: No. On iPhone, iPad and Android, updates arrive through the App Store and Google Play like any other app: automatically if automatic updates are on, otherwise from the Updates list in the store. Dovilo Desktop updates itself and picks up each new build on its own. This page is only for the first install.

Agents reach AI tasks only, the jobs you write for them in the AI Tasks tab, never your personal to-do list, and they cannot create or delete tasks. You need Pro and Dovilo 2.0 or later.

A breathing exercise and countdown ease you in, and when the session completes you earn bricks based on its duration.
focusSessions.a2: The timer keeps running in the background: switch apps or lock your phone and the time is still counted correctly, with a notification the moment it is done. Do Not Disturb can silence other apps for the length of the session. Only completed Pomodoro rounds count toward the daily round counter: single sessions and ones you end early do not.

ambience.a1: Ambience sets the mood of a focus session. A scene fills the whole screen and brings its own sound: Rainy City (rain and fireplace), Midnight (city hum over brown noise), Dusk (birds and breeze), Snow (winter wind and pink noise) or Fog (fog horn and white noise). The Default scene is always available and is silent.
ambience.a2: Under the Sound tab you can blend up to three layers at once and set the level of each: rain, fireplace, forest, waves, café, library, train, thunder, brown, pink or white noise. The mix can follow the session rhythm, opening softly in the first 5 minutes and brightening in the last 2, and the scene can switch to Dusk on its own when your break starts. It is ambience, not music: no melody, no beat.

build.q: How do I build my city?
build.a: Earn bricks by completing tasks and focus sessions. Visit the Market tab to browse and purchase buildings, decorations, and roads. Then place them on your isometric grid in the Dovilo tab. Your city grows as your productivity grows!

rearrange.a: You can demolish a building by tapping on it and selecting the demolish option. This refunds a portion of the bricks, and you can then place a new building wherever you like.

pro.a: Pro includes everything in the free tier, plus: planning with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok, where the assistant proposes and you approve in Dovilo; AI Agents like Claude Code and Cursor working through 15 AI tasks a month; Dovilo Desktop for Windows and Mac; cloud sync across devices; the Focus Ambience Pack (5 scenes, 16 sound layers: 13 recordings and 3 generated noises); the Full City Package (every building, decoration and upgrade); advanced statistics; +6 build permits a day; and a 30-minute snooze from the reminder notification. Both one-time content packs are included with Pro, not sold again. Unlimited tasks and categories, reminders and a zero-ad experience are free-tier features, not Pro ones, and there are no custom themes.

options.a1: Dovilo Pro is $2.49 a month, $19.99 a year or $49.99 once, with a 7-day trial in the app. All plans include the same Pro features.
options.a2: There are also one-time purchases that are not subscriptions: the Focus Ambience Pack ($4.99: 5 scenes and 16 sound layers), the Full City Package ($4.99: every building, decoration and upgrade), and AI task packs from $0.99. Both packs are already included with Pro.

aiTasks.q: How many AI tasks does Pro include?
aiTasks.a: 15 AI tasks a month. A task counts when it opens to your agent, not when you create it, and replies on the same task cost nothing. If you need more, one-time top-up packs add 10, 30 or 75 AI tasks, start at $0.99 and never expire.

ambiencePack.q: Do I need the Focus Ambience Pack?
ambiencePack.a: No. Focus sessions and Pomodoro cycles are free and unlimited, and the Default scene is always available and is simply silent. The pack adds the 5 atmospheric scenes and the 16 sound layers you can blend three at a time. It is a one-time $4.99 purchase, and Pro subscribers already have it.

cancel.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
cancel.a: Subscriptions are managed through the Apple App Store or Google Play Store. To cancel, go to your device's subscription settings. You'll retain Pro access until the end of your current billing period.

plan.q: Can I plan with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok?
plan.a1: Yes. Add Dovilo to the assistant as a custom connector with the URL https://dovilo.app/mcp and sign in with your Dovilo account. The assistant proposes a plan, the plan lands in the AI inbox on your phone, and it goes into your lists with one tap once you approve it.
plan.a2: For each connection you choose what the assistant can read and which lists and projects it sees, and its changes always wait for your approval; the setting is called Ask me first. There is no delete tool, and you can revoke a connection from your phone at any time. Sending a plan works on Free; approving it, and everything else, needs Pro.

mcp.a1: Dovilo runs two remote Model Context Protocol servers. Agents MCP, at https://dovilo.app/mcp/agents, is for coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, Windsurf, Codex CLI and Gemini CLI. Each agent connects with its own key and gets nine tools: list_tasks, get_task, read_context, update_status, update_step, add_step, skip_step, append_note and append_telemetry. Those tools reach AI tasks only, the jobs you write for an agent in the AI Tasks tab, inside the projects you assign to it. Your personal to-do list in My Tasks is not on its tool surface, and no agent can create or delete a task.
mcp.a2: Personal MCP, at https://dovilo.app/mcp, is for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok, which propose plans and tasks for you to approve. Setup and the trust boundaries are on the developer page, and every tool with its inputs is in the MCP reference.

desktop.q: Does my coding agent need Dovilo Desktop running?
desktop.a: No. Since Dovilo 2.0, coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor connect to Dovilo's remote MCP server at https://dovilo.app/mcp/agents with a key you create in the app, from your laptop, a server or a CI runner. Desktop does not need to be open; it is the desktop client for your lists and AI tasks. The agent sees only the AI tasks of the projects you assign to it, and it cannot create or delete tasks. Agents are part of Pro. Coming from Desktop 1.8? Its built-in MCP server stops working with 2.0, so reconnect your agent with the new URL and a new key. Setup is on the developer page.

connect.q: How do I connect Claude Code, Cursor, or another AI agent?
connect.a: Create the agent in the app first. In the mobile app, open AI Agents and tap New agent; in Dovilo Desktop, use Connect a new AI. Give it a name, pick the projects it may work on and create its key, which is shown once. Then add the server URL https://dovilo.app/mcp/agents to your client, with the key as a bearer token in the Authorization header. The connect flow has presets for Claude Code, Cursor, Cursor CLI, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Windsurf and Claude Desktop, shows where each config goes and fills in your key.

clients.q: Which AI clients does Dovilo support?
clients.a: The connect flow has presets for Claude Code, Cursor (app and CLI), Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Windsurf and Claude Desktop. Anything else that speaks MCP over HTTP, LangGraph or a CI job included, connects with the same URL and key, so Dovilo doesn't lock you to a specific vendor. For planning rather than coding, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok connect to Personal MCP.

authorize.q: Can agents create or modify tasks I didn't authorize?
authorize.a: No. The agent tools have no create and no delete. An agent can read its AI tasks, update their status, mark steps, leave notes and report telemetry, and it can cancel a task it should not run, with a reason; the task stays in your list, shown as Cancelled. You decide which tasks an agent sees by assigning it projects, each with a brief the agent reads first. Deleting an agent stops its key right away. Chat assistants on Personal MCP only propose: plans, AI tasks and every change to an AI task wait for your approval.

notified.q: Do I get notified when an agent works on my task?
notified.a: Yes. You can choose between two notification modes: every step (each progress update the agent pushes) or start / finish / error only (quieter, summary-style). The AI Tasks tab is in the mobile app as well, so you can write an AI task from your phone and follow the same run there: step trail, agent notes and telemetry (tokens, cost, duration) all land on the task, wherever the agent runs. When an agent stops with a question, you answer it from the task.

webhooks.q: Can Dovilo send task events to Slack, Linear, or my own service?
webhooks.a1: Yes. Dovilo sends HMAC-signed HTTPS webhooks when an AI task is created or changes status (task.created and task.status_changed), so you can bridge Dovilo into Slack, Linear, n8n, LangGraph, or any custom receiver. Public HTTPS receivers are delivered by Dovilo's server, even when Desktop is closed; localhost receivers are delivered by Desktop while it is open, and the app labels them Local. Each delivery includes a Stripe-style X-Dovilo-Signature header for verification, a unique X-Dovilo-Delivery id for idempotency, FIFO ordering per task, and up to 5 retries on transient failures. Set it up in Dovilo Desktop, in the project's List settings: paste your URL, pick the events, enable it and press Save, then generate the signing secret.
webhooks.a2: Full payload schema, signature verification examples (Node, Python, Go), and the retry policy live in the webhooks reference.

example.q: Is there an example webhook receiver I can copy from?
example.a: Yes. dovilo-langgraph-demo is an open-source LangGraph receiver that verifies the Dovilo signature, fans events out, and drives an agent through MCP end-to-end.

offline.a: Yes. Dovilo is offline-first. All your tasks, focus sessions, and city progress are stored locally on your device. You don't need an internet connection to use the app. Cloud sync is an optional Pro feature.

sync.a: With Pro, you can sign in with Google or Apple and sync your data across multiple devices via Firebase. Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest. You can trigger a manual sync from Settings at any time.

deleteAccount.q: Can I delete my account and data?
deleteAccount.a: Yes. Go to Settings > Delete Account to permanently remove your account and all cloud-synced data. Local data is removed when you uninstall the app. Cloud data is fully deleted within 30 days of account deletion.

ads.a: No. Dovilo is completely ad-free, both in the free tier and in Pro. We believe ads break focus, which is the opposite of what a productivity app should do.

export.a: Not yet. There is no data export today; it is on the roadmap and this page will say so when it ships. Your tasks, focus sessions and city live on your device, and cloud sync is an optional Pro feature.

faq.closing: Still have questions? support [at] dovilo.app
